note: Machine-readable index of every data source CostAnswer uses, evaluates or has rejected. Licence fields are read from the source's own LICENSE/terms, never inferred from a repository name or from memory. A source may not enter production unless commercialUse is 'permitted'.

trustLevels.primary: The body that creates the number. Its own publication is the authority.
trustLevels.secondary: Republishes or compiles primary figures. Usable to find and cross-check, never as the final value.
trustLevels.discovery: Not a data source. Used to locate the primary document, or to learn structure.
trustLevels.rejected: Evaluated and excluded. The reason is recorded so it is not re-evaluated.

sources.name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
sources.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
limitations: Suppressed estimates for small cells
Metro release is 40 MB and needs tier-2 storage

sources.name: BLS Consumer Price Index (CPI-U)
sources.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
limitations: Not construction-specific; PPI is the right index for materials

sources.name: BLS Producer Price Index
sources.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Index
usefulFields: commodity indexes for lumber, roofing, concrete, HVAC equipment
limitations: Gives movement, not an absolute retail price

sources.name: BLS Employer Costs for Employee Compensation
sources.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
usefulFields: wages as a share of total compensation, by industry
limitations: Industry aggregates, not trade-specific crews

sources.name: BEA Regional Price Parities
sources.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
usefulFields: all-items and services price parity by area
limitations: Whole-basket parity, not a construction-cost index

sources.name: IRS annual inflation adjustments and Publication 15
State Departments of Revenue — instruction booklets, withholding guides, rate schedules
sources.version: tax year 2026 where published, otherwise latest
sources.license: U.S. state government works; generally public domain or freely publishable
sources.attribution: Named per state in the snapshot
limitations: Most agency sites refuse programmatic HTML requests: of eleven probed, four returned 403, two failed DNS, one 404'd on its own published path, one sat behind bot detection
PDFs are reachable where HTML is not, and are the working route
Withholding tables are not annual liability and must not be transcribed as such

sources.name: PolicyEngine US — tax and benefit parameters
sources.licenseVerifiedFrom: GitHub licence API on the repository itself
usefulFields: metadata.reference[] — title and href pointing at the official state document for each parameter
values[] keyed by effective date, which reveals when a rate changes
consumers: tax-engine (as an index, not as data)
sources.validationSource: the official document each reference points to
limitations: AGPL-3.0 is copyleft: its parameter files and code are not copied into this project
Used strictly as a pointer to the primary document, which is then fetched and transcribed independently
A value taken from here without opening its reference would be unverified

sources.name: OpenConstructionEstimate DDC-CWICR
sources.geography: China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Russia, Greece, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Brazil
sources.license: Dual: DATA is CC BY-NC 4.0; CODE is Apache-2.0; long-form PDFs fully reserved
sources.licenseVerifiedFrom: the repository's own LICENSE and LICENSE-CODE.txt files, read 2026-09-06
usefulFields: structure only: work item, resource, unit, assembly, productivity
limitations: Data licence is NonCommercial, so it cannot enter a commercial product
It also contains no United States dataset at all — the country directories are Asia, CIS, Europe and Brazil
Rejected twice over. Its schema design is Apache-2.0 in the code and may be learned from; the cost data may not be used

sources.name: FEMA Schedule of Equipment Rates
sources.attribution: Source: FEMA Schedule of Equipment Rates
usefulFields: hourly rate by equipment class and capacity
limitations: Reimbursement rates for disaster work, not a rental market price

sources.name: Davis-Bacon prevailing wage determinations
sources.attribution: Source: U.S. Department of Labor, Davis-Bacon wage determinations
usefulFields: base rate and fringe by trade and county
limitations: Prevailing wage on federally funded work is a regional benchmark, not a residential market price
Using it directly would overstate typical residential labour

sources.name: Census Building Permits Survey and city/county permit datasets
sources.geography: national, metro, county; municipal open-data portals
sources.license: U.S. Government work, public domain; municipal portals vary
sources.attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau; named municipality
limitations: Permit valuation is not a final invoice and must be used as calibration evidence, never as ground truth
Each municipality's licence must be checked separately before ingest

sources.name: State DOT bid tabulations and average unit prices
sources.license: State government works, generally public domain
usefulFields: unit prices for concrete, asphalt, excavation, grading, drainage, hauling, demolition
limitations: Public infrastructure pricing differs from residential contractor pricing; use for sanity checking

sources.name: NREL ResStock
sources.license: U.S. Government work / NREL open data
limitations: Building and energy context, not a price database
